CustomObject.description: Steps of a job dispatcher (Batch_JobDispatcher): our own Subscription25 batch classes, run one after another in Order__c order. Saves Scheduled Apex slots (max 100 per org): one dispatcher schedule replaces a schedule per batch. Subscription25 package jobs (Job_Synchronisation etc.) cannot be steps: their classes are not visible outside the package.
CustomObject.label: Job Dispatcher Step
